splits.method: stratified by family, 90/5/5 train/val/test, per-family shuffle with random.Random(42); same algorithm as v0.1/v0.2 (scripts/build_v01_dataset.py, build_v02_dataset.py)

validation.note: v0.3 = v0.2 corpus (1,180, validated at v0.2 incl. re-run of all fix-changed rows) + batch 5 (900, flags from gen run 005, which included a mutation-tested intent-match self-check gate: 15/15 hand-corrupted rows caught). The full 2,080-row corpus was additionally audited with scripts/intent_match.py: 2,057/2,080 pass. The 23 flagged rows are all batch-5 vlan_l2 multi-VLAN rows where the checker mis-pairs port groups across multiple assignment sentences ('Put ... in VLAN N' / '... belong to VLAN N'); all 232 intent port->VLAN pairs in those rows were independently re-parsed and verified against the configs - zero real mismatches, checker not modified. See data/v0.3/intent_match_results.jsonl.

integrity.routable_ip_tokens: all globally-routable dotted quads are OSPF/BGP router-id identifiers (conventional lab placeholders, e.g. 1.1.1.1) in v0.1 seed-era rows; every assigned address, peer, network and next-hop is RFC1918 or an IETF documentation range
